Known for his systems-level thinking and patient-centered approach, Dr. Laband has held numerous leadership roles including Chief Resident at Maine Medical Center and Medical Director of multiple organizations. He earned his MD from Tufts University School of Medicine and completed his residency at Maine Medical Center. He also co-founded HippocratesVC, the world's first physician-funded social impact venture capital firm focused on digital therapeutics. Services by Dr. Paul Laband Advanced Lab Testing Med Matrix in South Portland, Maine runs 80+ biomarker lab panels that go far beyond standard bloodwork. We test full thyroid (TSH, free T3, free T4, reverse T3, antibodies), fasting insulin, inflammatory markers, sex hormones, cortisol, vitamin D, B12, and metabolic panels. Your provider reviews every result in a 60-minute consultation. Learn more → Heart Health Your cholesterol numbers tell one piece of the story. We test the full picture: particle size, inflammatory markers, insulin resistance, homocysteine, and metabolic function. Most heart disease risk factors are invisible on a standard lipid panel. Learn more → Longevity & Anti-Aging Aging is inevitable. Declining is not. We use advanced testing, hormone optimization, peptide therapy, and metabolic protocols to help you maintain energy, strength, cognitive function, and quality of life as you age.
